channel.title: ThoughtSo Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
Live Meeting Transcription

See the conversation as it happens — fully on-device.

  • Live rolling transcript in the meeting view while recording: your voice labeled "You", everyone else "Others"; first text ~8s after speech, updates every ~6s
  • Floating transcript window: movable, resizable, pinnable above full-screen Zoom/Meet on any Space; auto-open via menu bar → "Live Transcript Window"
  • Post-meeting, the live transcript is replaced automatically by the full speaker-diarized version
  • Crash-safe: live transcript persisted every 30 seconds
  • Echo protection on speakers: remote voices bleeding into the mic are deduplicated
  • Pure add-on to recording — live transcription failures never affect the meeting recording

item.title: Version 1.9.5
item.description:
Recording reliability — duplicate-stop fix

Critical fix for a 1.9.1 regression where clicking Stop twice could overwrite a recorded meeting with an empty result.

  • Explicit meeting lifecycle (idle/starting/recording/stopping/processing) with sessionID tracking — duplicate stops are no-ops
  • Capture audio is staged in ~/Documents/ThoughtSo/MeetingAudio/<id>/ before processing so it survives crashes
  • Recording-critical mode pauses KB indexing, workspace reparse, live insights, and Command Center LLM while a meeting captures
  • Capture-health telemetry on mic + system audio; silent dictation now skips STT and shows a clear mic warning
  • Partial captures are processed (mic-only or system-only) instead of failing entirely
  • AudioRecorder purpose split (dictation vs meeting) with distinct publish throttles
  • Bigger default main window (1280×820, min 960×640); cross-meeting chat hidden while retrieval is rebuilt

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
• Unified recording view: MeetingEditorView is now used during recording (replaces LiveMeetingView)
  • Recording banner with pulsing indicator, elapsed time, and stop button
  • Live transcript streams directly into Notes tab during recording
  • Prep, Notes, and Outcomes tabs accessible during recording
  • Auto-navigation to editor when recording starts (including from hotkey)
  • Short recording cleanup: skeleton meetings discarded for <5s recordings

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
• Fix local model thinking/reasoning leakage (Qwen3.5 additionalContext)
  • Redesigned settings into card-based UI with modular views
  • Unified design language across meetings views
  • Local LLM quality test harness
